workflow.title: Review app leftovers before uninstalling on macOS Tahoe
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide which app-associated files to retain before moving an app to Trash, rather than indiscriminately deleting every name match.
workflow.descriptionDirection: Lead with the distinction between an ownership match and permission to remove; explain review and restoration boundaries for Mac owners on macOS 26+.
outline: Immediately after the lead: cleared Peel leftover-review screenshot, once rights and visual checks pass (P05).
Read the match reason; shared team identifiers and app names are not permission. Explain preselected versus held-back items without promising correct classification (P05).
Review preferences, support data and recent-document records separately; leave uncertain/irreplaceable material untouched. Back up what matters; do not run cleanup for this article.
Separate a Trash move, potential space and actual available space. History depends on items remaining in Trash and has a 20,000-item limit (P06); disclose exceptions (P07).
Explain Full Disk Access, App Management and helper scope as optional coverage/authority decisions, not steps to bypass protections (P10).

Later visual: labeled Breathing Room Space example preview. For investigating ongoing space/activity rather than full app removal, discuss source-level inspection with disclosure and preview/hosted/Python caveats (B01-B05).
End with a keep/review/move decision checklist and link to the concise comparison; no fabricated FAQ, benchmark or recovered-space total.
workflow.interactionPass: A local-only decision checklist: app-only match? shared data? original data backed up? permission-limited unknown? reversible action? Outputs retain/review, never auto-delete. Handoff only; no website implementation authorized.
workflow.distinctFromComparison: Teaches evidence/retention decisions for an app's leftover plan; comparison instead selects between maintenance workflows.
prohibitions: No guaranteed complete removal or safe savings
No executable cleanup tutorial without separate reproduction
